Cardholder verification inquiries confirmed that the activity was unauthorized and executed without the knowledge or consent of customer C13487. Network link analysis revealed shared infrastructure connectivity linking the originating device profile or network origin to 51 additional payment cards across the institution, indicating organized syndicate operation (Rule R6). In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 and regulatory guidance, payment card C13487-K1 was immediately placed under block status to prevent further losses, and full reimbursement procedures have been initiated for customer C13487. The institution maintains all underlying transaction records, audit logs, and graph relationship artifacts available for law enforcement inspection under reference HHG-014.
